user_prompt: We need to streamline our complete purchasing workflow to examine incoming client requests, evaluate buyer participation levels and regulatory standards, vet potential vendors, and give the green light for transaction completion with appropriate authorizations. As orders move through each phase, we also need to track their progression through various completion checkpoints and monitor delivery timelines. Additionally, include functionality to handle any customer grievances or billing disagreements that may arise during the transaction lifecycle, ensuring we can document claims and work through resolutions efficiently within our existing business platform.

steps.step_name: Track order progression through completion checkpoints

args.content:
LANDSCAPE OVERVIEW (10 systems, updated with order tracking):
- corp.itsm: IT Service Management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, change automation, safety)
- emarsys.cx: Customer Experience/Marketing (campaign optimization, opportunity engagement)
- my.mes: Manufacturing Execution (quality monitoring, production coordination, order sequencing)
- sap.ariba: Procurement (vendor invoicing, compliance, material coordination)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity qualification, campaign targeting, sales compensation)
- sap.ehs: Environment, Health, Safety (incident analysis, vendor compliance, response coordination, campaign orchestration, product safety validation)
- sap.odm: ODM entity type taxonomy (40 canonical entity types)
- sap.s4: ERP (procurement matching, BOM compliance, order automation, opportunity-to-order)
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HR (performance reviews, compensation, talent acquisition)
- siemens.plm: Product Lifecycle Management (BOM validation, engineering changes, component design)
- workday.hcm: Human Capital Management (compensation, performance reviews, safety)

KEY ORDER TRACKING RESOURCES:
- my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1 — Sequences work orders, coordinates material flow, orchestrates production execution, tracks orders through production pipeline with real-time scheduling
- sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1 — Monitors opportunities and automates order creation, coordinates with procurement and production to ensure fulfillment readiness
- corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1 — Tracks product item assignments to change orders, coordinates provisioning workflows

RESOLVED ACTIVITIES (updated):
1. Handle customer grievances → REFUSED
2. Reconcile disagreements during fulfillment → sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
3. Verify material specifications against master records → sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
4. Review and align compensation structures with labor requirements → workday.hcm:agent:CompensationStructureAutomationEngine:v1
5. Validate financial structures against production budget needs → REFUSED
6. Identify priority customer segments from marketing campaigns → emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1
7. Pull customer account details and engagement history → emarsys.cx:agent:OpportunityEngagementOrchestrator:v1
8. Track workplace safety events during fulfillment → workday.hcm:agent:OccupationalSafetyIncidentMonitoring:v1
9. Maintain compliance records for safety incidents → workday.hcm:agent:OccupationalSafetyIncidentMonitoring:v1
10. Set up payroll and compensation documentation → workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation:v1
11. Design and validate product components → siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
12. Track order progression through completion checkpoints → my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
